claims.claim: The CRA (chapter 8 of title 5) bar prevents the BLM from issuing a substantially similar rule in the future without explicit congressional authorization.
claims.sourceSpan: congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code
claims.note: The title cites chapter 8 of title 5, but the 'substantially similar rule' reissuance bar (5 U.S.C. 801(b)(2)) does not appear in the bill text or the FR order; extrinsic legal context. Framed as a gap, not asserted as bill content; low impact.

claims.sourceSpan: such rule shall have no force or effect

claims.claim: Does not address the status of any tribal consultation obligations associated with the original order regarding the 1854 Ceded Territory of the Lake Superior Chippewa.
claims.sourceSpan: the 1854 Ceded Territory of the Lake Superior Chippewa
claims.note: The 1854 Ceded Territory is sourced; 'tribal consultation obligations' is extrinsic — the FR order references Tribes' cultural/subsistence resources but states no consultation obligation. Claim only asserts the resolution is silent on them (a gap); low impact.

claims.claim: The withdrawal was 'subject to valid existing rights' — a qualifier the analysis does not surface.
claims.sourceSpan: subject to valid existing rights
claims.note: The FR order withdrew the land 'subject to valid existing rights'; the analysis omits this qualifier. Minor context; does not change the disapproval's effect of reopening the land.

notes: Bill is a one-sentence CRA disapproval (Public Law 119-85) of BLM Public Land Order No. 7917; all substantive figures/entities trace to the registered referencedSource fr-2023-01969 (88 FR 6308), which was fetched and read in full. Every figure (225,504 acres, 20 years, 88 FR 6308, Jan 31 2023, Apr 27 2026) matches source exactly; no direction inversion, wrong-account, or fabricated-entity error found. Four minor items: 'Congressional Review Act' / 'by the President' are accurate glosses of cited-but-not-verbatim source ('chapter 8 of title 5', 'Approved'); 'Boundary Waters watershed' conflates the Rainy River Watershed with the BWCAW; two gaps rows (CRA reissuance bar, tribal consultation obligations) are extrinsic synthesis framed as omissions the resolution does not address. One minor coverage omission: 'subject to valid existing rights'. criticisms[]/featured_quotes[] (CR floor quotes) were out of scope for this pass and not verifiable against the fetched sources (Congressional Record not registered as a referencedSource).
